rationale: AmCham member roster enumerates MK banks/payments and foreign investors — mine once for the actor map, not a continuous signal feed.

Non-bank/fintech association publishing member-accession and governance posts — clearly in scope, but URL check failed so re-verify liveness first.

Facebook page used only as a proxy for an unconfirmed chamber website; low signal density, revisit once the real domain is found.

Specialist MK banking trade press naming officials at association/NBRM events — a durable A5 leadership-move feed.
Business outlet reporting association elections and executive appointments with dates — solid secondary A5 source.
Government-curated index of chambers/associations; mine once for discovery, then archive.
Archival US-government association enumeration useful as a completeness cross-check only; currency low.
LinkedIn org feeds are the fastest source of hires and board changes but require login/ToS clearance before monitoring.

Ministry-of-Finance sub-page duplicating BJN/ESJN content; fold into finance.gov.mk monitoring and re-check the failed URL.
Treasury section of finance.gov.mk — relevant to public payment rails but a sub-page; URL failed, re-verify.
Transaction-level spending portal corroborates awards and exposes unannounced banking/IT supplier contracts.

State audit reports detail banking/IT procurement and buyer org structure; reliable but retrospective and low cadence.
Central-bank procurement page is the top payments-programme proxy; in scope, but URL verification failed — re-check liveness.
Customs tender-dossier directory listing may not be browsable; valuable PDFs with expert profiles, re-verify the path.
Distributed ministry procurement pages mirror notices with local contact officers; URL failed, confirm the vlada.mk entry point.

IPA programming documents flag PFM/payments interventions before tenders exist — a genuine leading indicator.
